# Card layout lets wide grid panes escape their viewport

## Context

A constrained Grid or TreeGrid can start narrower than its host, then gain horizontal overflow when a user widens a column. An independent browser reproduction against the Engine's current layout rules measured a 375px Card host whose pane expanded to 770px of intrinsic content. Because the grid then received a 770px viewport, its 770px column set produced no scroll range.

Applying the Flexbox min-size release at the Card-child boundary kept the pane at 375px while preserving 770px of scrollable content.

Live latest-open sweep: checked the latest 20 open issues on 2026-08-27 immediately before filing; no equivalent found. The latest 30 A2A messages contained no overlapping lane claim. Knowledge Base and local issue/discussion sweeps found related historical grid and flex-containment work, but no open ticket for this mechanism.

## The Problem

The Card layout gives each direct child `flex: 1 0 100%`, but does not release Flexbox's default `min-width: auto` / `min-height: auto`. A pane with wide intrinsic content therefore refuses to shrink to the Card viewport. In a tab container, the body clips the oversized pane; the nested grid never observes a viewport narrower than its columns, so its horizontal scrollbar correctly has nothing to scroll.

This affects Grid and TreeGrid equally because both use the same Grid container and horizontal-scrollbar path. It is not a scrollbar-configuration defect.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/scss/src/layout/Card.scss` owns Card-item geometry, including direct children and the transition wrapper.
- `src/layout/Card.mjs` projects the active card either directly or beneath `.neo-animation-wrapper`.
- `src/tab/Container.mjs` places tab panes in a Card-layout body; `resources/scss/src/tab/Container.scss` clips that body.
- `src/dashboard/DockLayoutAdapter.mjs` already releases the same automatic min-content floor on projected split-zone children. Merged PR `#15018` established the Engine precedent one flex boundary higher.
- Grid's horizontal scrollbar already derives its range from the rendered center-column width. It must remain unchanged.

## The Fix

Release the automatic minimum size for both Card render paths in `resources/scss/src/layout/Card.scss`:

- direct Card children;
- children inside `.neo-animation-wrapper`.

Use `min-width: 0` and `min-height: 0` at that layout-owned boundary. Explicit component inline minimum sizes remain authoritative through normal CSS precedence.

Add focused browser regression coverage that constrains a Card/Tab viewport, widens a column beyond it, and proves the Grid/TreeGrid pane stays host-sized while horizontal scrolling reaches the final column.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Card-layout child sizing | `resources/scss/src/layout/Card.scss` | Active cards may shrink below intrinsic content size on both axes | Explicit component `minWidth` / `minHeight` still win inline | Existing layout docs remain accurate | Rendered constrained-host regression |
| Grid/TreeGrid horizontal overflow | Existing Grid scrollbar path | Column totals wider than the rendered viewport produce horizontal scroll range | Existing fixed/flex column semantics unchanged | None | Resize-driven browser regression |

## Decision Record impact

none — this restores CSS containment within existing Card and Grid contracts.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Direct Card children can shrink to their rendered host below intrinsic content width and height.
- [ ] Card children rendered through `.neo-animation-wrapper` have the same containment behavior.
- [ ] A constrained Grid can begin without horizontal overflow, gain it through column resizing, remain parent-width, and horizontally reach its final column.
- [ ] The same regression contract holds for TreeGrid.
- [ ] An explicit component minimum size remains honored as a positive control.
- [ ] Focused unit/component/e2e suites covering the changed surfaces are green.

## Out of Scope

- Changing Grid or TreeGrid scrollbar creation/configuration.
- Redefining fixed-width versus flex-column semantics.
- Adding application-specific pane styles.
- Applying a global min-size rule to every Neo component.
- Refactoring Card transitions or dock projection.

## Avoided Traps

- A global widget-base `min-width: 0` rule is broader than the failing contract and would change intrinsic sizing in unrelated flex contexts.
- Modifying Grid scrollbar logic would mask the oversized viewport instead of repairing its owning layout boundary.
- Removing the tab body's clipping would move overflow outward rather than give the grid the correct viewport.
